tool.name: Merge GitHub Pull Request
tool.description: Merge a pull request on GitHub using the GitHub connector. Requires owner, repo, and pull_number parameters, with optional commit_title, commit_message, merge_method (merge/squash/rebase), and sha parameters.

sha.description: SHA that pull request head must match to allow merge

repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

pull_number.description: The number that identifies the pull request

commit_title.description: Title for the automatic commit message

commit_message.description: Extra detail to append to automatic commit message

parameters.args: {{ ({ owner: input.owner, repo: input.repo, pull_number: input.pull_number, commit_title: input.commit_title, commit_message: input.commit_message, merge_method: input.merge_method, sha: input.sha }) }}
